# restic unlock prints nothing and exits 0 when it removes nothing: here, first
# while the job pc-k3j9x2m4q8w1z7v still ran (its lock was under a minute old), then
# after it was killed (SIGKILL), from another host. Run on the host
# pc-k3j9x2m4q8w1z7v itself, the same unlock found the PID gone and removed the
# lock: "successfully removed 1 locks" on the standard output. A lock file
# restic cannot read stays: unlock skips it.
$ restic unlock
--- stdout
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ restic unlock
--- stdout
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ restic unlock
--- stdout
successfully removed 1 locks
--- stderr
--- exit 0
$ restic unlock
--- stdout
--- stderr
--- exit 0
